brief: Wave 1 B1+C+F+E read-only code review against d0e7374a

goals.title: Baseline reproduction
goals.objective: Establish governing artifacts, changed files, forbidden-test history, and observed targeted test baseline
goals.evidence: Read plan Wave 1 section, ADR, spec/TDD/FRs, and all available Wave 0 round-2 gate reports; confirmed commit ancestry C->B1->F->E and operator authorship; git diff was empty for all three protected test files both across d0e7374a..HEAD and 2c97b0bb^..2c97b0bb, with identical blob IDs; scoped agent test reproduced the expected sole failure TestEncodeImageToDataURL_NonDecodableReturnsEmpty while new no-passthrough behavior logged decode failure.

goals.title: Causal slice review
goals.objective: Evaluate at least three competing defect hypotheses and trace B1/C/F/E data flows end to end
goals.evidence: Traced B1/C/F/E end-to-end on committed fba0acbf using graphify, source, git grep/blame, detached-worktree lint, and generated Zod execution. Found blocking causes: E emits two out-of-contract codes (both rejected by ErrorFrame.safeParse), FR-017a relabel state has no production reader and tests use a test-only mirror, retry gating accepts CodeProviderRejected and image-primary errors bypass the helper; F rejects over-budget source bytes before resize and uses legacy 20MB/hardcoded 7680 rather than C budgets; B1 verified bytes cannot feed F's guarded decoder without duplicate logic; C exact IDs miss real protocol-prefixed models, compiled seed is unexported and no consumer/store/timer exists, checksum fetch fails open; B1 upload/delete lacks shared locking. Exact new-from-rev lint found 9 Wave-1 issues. Rejected protected-test mutation hypothesis via identical blobs; rejected codegen drift via make verify-contracts exit 0.

goals.title: Report verification
goals.objective: Write the requested review with severity counts, rejected hypotheses, and verify the artifact plus repository scope
goals.evidence: Wrote docs/internal/reviews/wave1-review-round1-code-reviewer.md with REVISE verdict, 0 CRIT / 11 MAJOR, five non-blocking findings, protected-test proof, causal chains, verification evidence, and rejected hypotheses; target remains the sole requested untracked review artifact.
